name: Wu Ji Zhi Tan 2D
source:
Eggy, an otaku, wakes up one day to find himself transformed into a cute girl?! 

Ballshit 2D reimagines the original live-action story as a 2D visual novel. Follow Eggy through campus life, friendships, awkward romance, and absurd surprises, with new 2D art, CGs, and the original voice acting.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5208460]Steam[/url]]
translation:
宅男蛋蛋一觉醒来，竟发现自己摇身一变成了可爱的美少女？！

《无基之谈2D》将原作真人互动故事重新演绎为2D视觉小说。伴随蛋蛋体验笑料百出的校园日常、真挚友情、尴尬恋情与荒诞离奇的突发惊喜，尽享全新绘制的2D立绘、精美CG以及原汁原味的原版配音演出。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5208460]Steam[/url]]
